description: This file defines the interface for the IControlModuleService and its factory within the Rialto media server IPC component. It declares methods for creating service instances and managing IPC client connections.

classes.name: IControlModuleServiceFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of IControlModuleService.

classes.name: IControlModuleService
classes.description: Interface for the control module service, managing IPC client connections.

methods.name: createFactory
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to a new IControlModuleServiceFactory instance.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to an IControlModuleService, given playback and control services.

methods.name: clientConnected
methods.description: Handles logic when an IPC client connects.

methods.name: clientDisconnected
methods.description: Handles logic when an IPC client disconnects.
